experience: As the optional-role newcomer, I could participate in every prepared round without inside knowledge. My 1989 donation secret made my role understandable, and the explicit questions let me contribute without inventing museum expertise. I felt more like a witness helping classify evidence than a socially connected participant. The final intersection was satisfying but very explicit.
fun_reason: Distinct motives and character voices gave the first round texture. By Method the same three-column classification dominated; the deduction was clear, but my individual relationships did not influence it.

navigation.assessment: Round titles and STOP instructions make sequence clear. Two question pages plus an answer page create repeated searching.
navigation.visual_page_07: Readable headings, separated branch boxes, a visible STOP line and two note lines. Both branches are fully visible together.
navigation.visual_page_10: The innocent answer box starts immediately beneath the header divider. In the supplied PNG, Your answer, its reading instruction, and IF INNOCENT are not visible above that box; IF MURDERER is visible. There is no visible notes area on this page. This is an observed image issue, not a tested printer issue.

question_matching.assessment: All prepared questions matched the responding character's named group. My turn as asker changed partners each round, preventing complete exclusion.
quotes: Ask one question addressed to that name.
Choose by name / Everyone answers once / Turn only within this round
question_matching.limit: Prepared table read verifies written matching only; live turn selection, host tracking, and improvisation were not tested.

repetition.assessment: The question grouping and turn instructions repeat on each page, which helps independent use. Opportunity and Method answers repeat nearly identical syntax sixteen times and reduce attention to name/time/key/cloth.
quotes: I borrowed the cabinet key during setup to inspect
That was what the materials desk issued me.

sixteen_present_vs_thirty_listed.assessment: I was told to ignore absent guests, so absent names did not block progress. However each round displayed thirty names while only sixteen attended. As a newcomer I had to compare unfamiliar names with the attendance list, especially optional names mixed beside core roles.
sixteen_present_vs_thirty_listed.change: Provide a small checked attendee list or clearly mark absent names on question pages before handing packets out.

note_space.assessment: Page 07 shows only two ruled lines. That is enough for a short leading guess but too little for comparing sixteen names across timing and key access. Method's supplied PNG has no visible notes area.
note_space.change: Add a compact attendee evidence grid or separate single-page note sheet with salon, key and linen columns.

memory_load.assessment: There are sixteen pun names, three investigation rounds and two time windows. Persistent records made this manageable in the table read. Animal comparison was straightforward in the simulation.
memory_load.limit: I did not test real human memory, spoken-only retention, or physical slip return.

actual_disclosures: The Opportunity text and page 07 exposed my own IF MURDERER alternative visit of 6:45 alongside my innocent 6:36 visit.
The Method text and page 10 exposed my own murderer salon record of 6:45. The image displays the murderer heading while the innocent heading is not visible.
I saw no other guest's private branch, animal, or ending. The selected HIPPO announcement did not itself identify a person to me.
hypothetical_risks: A neighboring player might see the adjacent branch or hear its label if someone reads the heading aloud; this did not occur in the prepared transcript.
The missing innocent heading on the supplied Method PNG might make a human select the wrong box; I selected correctly using the earlier instructions and text.
branch_safety.quote: Read the box for your role when questioned. Keep its label private.

roleplay.assessment: My old accession decision is a concrete personal compromise and gives me something to say. The prepared answer reveals that complication in Motive, so its protection ends early. I have no specified public relationships despite the arrival task referring to them.
quotes: Protect your private complication until you decide disclosure helps you.
Use your public relationships to trade information rather than waiting for clues to come to you.
In 1989 I accepted one of Grant’s early donations with incomplete paperwork.
roleplay.change: Give Anya one named relationship and a short optional pre-dinner prompt connecting the old accession file to another attendee, while keeping the formal evidence unchanged.

prioritized_changes.change: Fix Method answer-page layout so Your answer, branch instruction and IF INNOCENT are visible and clearly attached to the first box.
prioritized_changes.evidence: Supplied packet-page-10.png lacks those labels at the top while IF MURDERER remains visible.
prioritized_changes.exact_quote: Read the box for your role when questioned. Keep its label private.

prioritized_changes.change: Provide an attendee-specific evidence note grid for the actual sixteen players.
prioritized_changes.evidence: Thirty listed names plus two Opportunity note lines requires extra tracking by a newcomer.
exact_quotes: Evidence connecting the salon, key and linen

prioritized_changes.change: Add one explicit public relationship for optional Anya and an optional conversational hook.
prioritized_changes.evidence: The arrival task assumes relationships not included in my supplied background; round participation works, but free conversation has less support.
prioritized_changes.exact_quote: Use your public relationships to trade information rather than waiting for clues to come to you.

prioritized_changes.change: Consider placing alternative branches behind a fold or on separate marked panels while retaining clear selection instructions.
prioritized_changes.evidence: Both of my private alternative timings were actually visible in this simulation. No mistaken reading or other player's branch disclosure occurred.

test_scope: Blinded asynchronous prepared-answer table read and inspection of supplied PNG pages 07 and 10. No live improvisation, physical handling, printing or human memory performance tested.
